The Al5Ti8(FeCoNi)86.9B0.1 (at.%) ingots were fabricated by melting high-purity ( > 99.9 wt.%) raw materials (Al, Ti, Fe, Co, Ni, and B) in a vacuum arc furnace under a protective argon atmosphere. Each ingot underwent 5 melting cycles and was then cast into a copper mold
The samples were subsequently heated to 1200 ◦C and held for 2 hours to achieve homogenization
These samples then underwent multiple cold-rolling passes to achieve a 70% deformation (reducing the thickness from 5 to 1.5 mm)
